description:
"Unleash a barrage of arrows at an enemy, dealing |cffffff60570|r Poison Damage over |cffffff4|r seconds. 

After dealing damage you poison the enemy, dealing an additional |cffffff32790|r Poison Damage over |cffffff8|r seconds after a |cffffff1|r second delay.  

You can move at full speed and are immune to all disabling effects while channeling this attack.

This ability is considered direct damage."
